description: This source file contains integration tests for delinquency actions within the Apache Fineract project. It tests creating, reading, updating, and validating delinquency pause/resume actions on loans, including backdating and overlapping periods, as well as checking their effects on delinquency calculations and reports.

classes.name: DelinquencyActionIntegrationTests
classes.description: A suite of integration tests for delinquency actions in the loan management system, covering pause and resume actions, validation, backdating, and their impact on delinquency calculations.

classes.name: InstallmentDelinquencyData
classes.description: Data class representing delinquency details for a specific installment bucket, including min and max age days and the delinquent amount.

methods.name: assertInstallmentDelinquencyBuckets
methods.description: Asserts that the actual installment level delinquency buckets match expected totals and configuration.

methods.name: calculateExpectedBucketTotals
methods.description: Calculates expected delinquency totals per bucket considering pause periods and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: pausePeriods
methods.description: Helper to generate pause period objects for assertions.
